about_the_game:
Enter a realm of terror where every shadow hides secrets waiting to be uncovered. In this intense co-op experience for up to four players, you'll explore a sprawling 50-room manor and descend into a sinister dungeon. A possessed woman and a demon baby add an unsettling presence to every dark corner. Engage in physics-based interactions, perform mysterious rituals, and search for elusive items and collectibles. Dare to step into the unknown and uncover the story that lurks behind every creaking door and eerie corridor.

• Co-op Multiplayer: Team up with up to 4 players for a haunting experience.

• Expansive Maps: Explore a sprawling 50-room manor and sinister dungeon depths.

• Unsettling Antagonists: Encounter a possessed woman and a demon baby that defy expectations.

• Interactive Environment: Engage with physics-based interactions and mysterious rituals.

• Hidden Secrets: Search meticulously for rare items and collectibles that reveal the story.
detailed_description:
🔥 HELLBORN EARLY ACCESS – JOIN THE RITUAL NOW! 🔥

The gates of hell have opened, and the nightmare begins. Get ready for an intense co-op horror experience where teamwork, strategy, and courage are your only hope for survival.

👻 Early Access Features Include:
✅ Online Co-Op (1-4 Players) – Face the terror together.
✅ Dynamic Haunting – The baby and possessed woman evolve, becoming more aggressive.
✅ Sacrifices & Rituals – Perform dark rites to weaken the demon.
✅ Unpredictable Horror – No two playthroughs are the same.

📢 Join our Discord and shape the future of Hellborn!

Dare to enter? The ritual awaits.
